recent: ISF Group 近期获得价值 RM83.2m 的数据中心相关合约，将订单簿推高至 RM225.5m。同时，公司董事及主要股东在 2026 年 9 月 23 日间接减持了 25,900,000 股普通股。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收和净利均环比增长。
notable: 获得价值 RM83.2m 的数据中心相关合约，订单簿增至 RM225.5m。

risks: 董事及主要股东间接减持 25,900,000 股，占已发行股份 2.590%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 31.385m，环比增长 19.9%；净利为 MYR 8.168m，环比增长 89.2%；净利率从 16.5% 升至 26.0%。

recent_en: ISF Group recently secured RM83.2m in data centre-related contracts, lifting its order book to RM225.5m. Meanwhile, directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed of 25,900,000 ordinary shares on 23 September 2026. Revenue and net profit both grew quarter-on-quarter in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Secured RM83.2m in data centre-related contracts, raising order book to RM225.5m.
Directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed of 25,900,000 ordinary shares on 23 September 2026.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder indirectly disposed of 25,900,000 shares, representing 2.590% of issued shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 31.385m, up 19.9% QoQ; net profit was MYR 8.168m, up 89.2% QoQ; net margin rose from 16.5% to 26.0%.
